notes.title: Launch Patch 2, 12/8
notes.content:
- Added additional graphics for the Forked Hallways.
- Updated the normals for the walls, making them stand out more in the light.
- The SCP-173 illusion has received new mechanics, making it both easier and more difficult to avoid in equal measure.

notes.title: Launch Patch 12/8
notes.content:
- A handful of bug fixes, including some strange texture reflections.
- The passive healing mechanic after being injured was not activating properly, it received a minor rework and now functions as intended.
